race.title: Careersinracing Step On Track Programme Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Not a convincing bunch so it's perhaps worth siding with WESTERN SOLDIER , who lurks on a very dangerous mark and offered a bit more at Fontwell 4 weeks ago. Zaraquelle will doubtless be popular, while Diamond Days can get back on track returned to hurdling. WESTERN SOLDIER (GER) ZARAQUELLE (FR) DIAMOND DAYS (IRE)
